template: After {wound}, they came to believe: "{belief}" So they {strategy}. It buys them {payoff}, but costs them {cost}. On an ordinary day they're {coping}. When they want something, they turn {negotiating}. When the wound gets poked, they go {conflict}. But when the armor slips, they're {wildcard}. Their arc: learning that {lesson}.
chain: wound -> belief -> strategy (implied by belief) -> traits (from strategy); payoff/cost from belief; lesson pool = belief lesson + strategy lessons

stance.assertive: moves against: takes up space, pushes for what it wants
stance.compliant: moves toward: earns safety by meeting expectations
stance.withdrawn: moves away: steps back into an inner world

outlook.positive: copes by staying upbeat and minimizing the problem
outlook.competency: copes by staying rational, capable and in control
outlook.reactive: copes by feeling it hard and needing others to respond

conflictMode.sharper: attacks: cutting, punishing, aimed at the other person
conflictMode.sideways: deflects: jokes, blames, intellectualizes, changes the subject

strategies.label: set out to get everything right
lessons: good enough is sometimes exactly right
joy isn't a reward for being perfect; it's allowed now
the inner critic isn't the voice of conscience

strategies.label: made themselves needed
lessons: you can ask for love directly instead of earning it
your own needs deserve the care you give everyone else
love that keeps score isn't the love you're after

strategies.label: set out to win
lessons: who you are is more interesting than what you've won
the truth about you beats the best version of you
failing in front of people won't kill you, and it might set you free

strategies.label: made themselves one of a kind
lessons: what you have is not less than what you're missing
an ordinary life can hold extraordinary feeling
your wound is part of your story, not the whole of it

strategies.label: retreated into understanding
lessons: you'll never know enough to feel ready, so act anyway
the world drains you less than hiding from it does
you don't have to ration yourself; there's more of you than you think

strategies.label: prepared for the worst
lessons: you can trust yourself as much as any authority
courage is acting with the fear, not waiting for it to leave
security is something you build inside, not something you find

strategies.label: kept everything fun
strategies.fear: being trapped in pain or deprivation
lessons: the pain you outrun follows you everywhere
staying with one thing is where the real joy is
the most satisfying life is the one you actually commit to

strategies.label: made sure no one could push them around
lessons: letting people see you soft is the bravest thing you'll do
real strength protects without needing to win
trust is a kind of strength you haven't trained yet

strategies.label: kept the peace at any cost
lessons: your presence matters, and so does your opinion
real peace includes you
showing up fully is worth the friction it creates

wounds.label: growing up as the easy kid in a house that only had attention for the difficult one
being the gifted kid everyone said would go far
growing up in the shadow of an older sibling who was the family star
being punished for telling the truth about something everyone else ignored
being the funny one in a family that couldn't handle sadness
being praised for being so mature since they were six
being mocked for how they talked at a new school
being told their dream was impractical by the people they most wanted to impress
a parent walked out one night and never came back
growing up in a house where any dinner could turn into a fight
being moved between eight schools before they turned twelve
a mentor they adored took credit for their breakthrough
spending their childhood holding the family together while a parent fell apart
their closest ally sold them out for a better offer
watching their parents' marriage go cold and quiet
losing the competition they'd trained years for by a fraction of a second
growing up with a parent whose love depended on their mood that day
being disowned by their family for the life they chose
growing up in a house where one bad month could cost the family everything
a first love who left without a word
being bullied for years while the adults looked away
a business they built collapsing and taking their friends' savings with it
a secret they confided being spread to everyone they knew
discovering their whole family history was a lie
someone in their care died on their watch
they followed an order that ruined innocent lives
being the only one who walked away from the crash
their home burning down with everything they'd ever made inside
fleeing a war that took their home and half their family
being falsely accused and losing years of their life to it

beliefs.label: Softness gets people killed, so show none.
payoffs: never hesitating when it counts
a reputation no one dares to test
costs: the trust of anyone weaker than them
the part of themselves that still flinches
beliefs.lesson: mercy is strength that has chosen its moment

beliefs.label: If I prepare for everything, no one else gets hurt.
payoffs: a plan for every disaster
the feeling that loss can be prevented
costs: the ability to rest
any moment that isn't a drill
beliefs.lesson: you can't prevent every loss, but you can stop losing your life to the fear of it

beliefs.label: If I keep everyone laughing, no one has to feel this.
payoffs: being the light in every room
never having to sit with the grief
costs: the chance to mourn
friends who wonder if they've ever met the real them
beliefs.lesson: grief shared is lighter than grief outrun

beliefs.label: I fail the people who depend on me, so let someone else lead.
payoffs: never being responsible for another loss
a quiet, uncomplicated life
costs: the leadership everyone can see they're capable of
the people who needed them to step up
beliefs.lesson: failing someone once doesn't make you a failure; staying out of the fight does

beliefs.label: If I'm useful enough, people will stay.
payoffs: a place in everyone's life
being the one people call first
costs: relationships that don't feel like jobs
knowing what they want for themselves
beliefs.lesson: the people worth keeping stay even when you have nothing to offer

beliefs.label: If I'm impressive enough, no one will leave me again.
payoffs: a résumé no one can walk away from
admiration on demand
costs: rest
being loved for anything they didn't earn
beliefs.lesson: the people who left weren't leaving because you weren't enough

beliefs.label: Nobody can abandon you if you never need them.
payoffs: total self-sufficiency
a life no one can take apart
costs: help when they need it most
anyone who wants to get close
beliefs.lesson: needing people isn't the danger; needing the wrong ones is

beliefs.label: Life's too short to dwell on who left.
payoffs: a life full of new people and new places
never looking back
costs: any relationship that needs them to stay through the hard part
ever getting an answer to why
beliefs.lesson: looking back is how you stop repeating it

beliefs.label: My needs aren't important, so don't make waves.
payoffs: being everyone's favorite low-maintenance friend
a life without fights
costs: their own voice
the life they'd have chosen if anyone had asked
beliefs.lesson: being easy isn't the same as being loved

beliefs.label: If I'm good enough, someone will finally notice.
payoffs: a spotless record
the moral high ground in every room
costs: the fun they never let themselves have
patience with anyone less careful
beliefs.lesson: you don't have to be flawless to deserve attention

beliefs.label: If I'm different enough, they'll have to notice me.
payoffs: a style no one can ignore
a story about themselves that feels important
costs: the comfort of belonging
any role that requires being ordinary
beliefs.lesson: being seen doesn't require being strange

beliefs.label: Someone has to keep things calm, and it's me.
payoffs: a gift for defusing any room
being the steady one
costs: ever getting to be upset themselves
conflicts that needed to happen
beliefs.lesson: some fights are worth having, and peace that excludes you isn't peace

beliefs.label: Never be the one at someone else's mercy.
payoffs: control of every situation
never feeling small again
costs: anyone who wants to be an equal
the chance to be taken care of
beliefs.lesson: being at someone's mercy and being in their care are not the same thing

beliefs.label: If I can see trouble coming, I can stop it.
payoffs: an uncanny read on any room
never being blindsided
costs: peace in quiet moments
people who feel watched rather than loved
beliefs.lesson: you don't have to scan every room once you're no longer a child in that house

beliefs.label: If I keep things fun, the fight never starts.
payoffs: being the life of every party
a talent for changing the mood
costs: ever being taken seriously
the conversations that never happen
beliefs.lesson: the fight you avoid with a joke is still waiting for you

beliefs.label: I'm only worth what I achieve, so never stop proving it.
payoffs: a steady supply of validation
a clear scoreboard for their worth
costs: rest
relationships that aren't audiences
beliefs.lesson: your worth was never up for negotiation

beliefs.label: Don't act until you've mastered it.
payoffs: encyclopedic knowledge of everything they care about
never looking foolish
costs: years of a life spent preparing
the things only doing can teach
beliefs.lesson: mastery comes from doing it badly first

beliefs.label: Commitment is a trap, so keep every option open.
payoffs: a potential that can never be disproven
an endless supply of new beginnings
costs: the depth that only commitment brings
the respect of people who watch them start and quit
beliefs.lesson: choosing one path doesn't shrink you; it's how you find out who you are

beliefs.label: Mistakes reveal what you really are, so never make one.
payoffs: work no one can criticize
never being exposed as a fraud
costs: every risk that would have mattered
the freedom to be a beginner
beliefs.lesson: failure is an event, not an identity

beliefs.label: Second place is the same as invisible, so win at everything.
payoffs: a trophy shelf that proves they exist
relentless motivation
costs: friendships that aren't contests
enjoying anything they're not good at
beliefs.lesson: the race was never against your sibling; it was against a story

beliefs.label: No one will ever really understand me, so stop expecting them to.
payoffs: a rich, private inner life
a sense of being special in their suffering
costs: the people trying to understand them right now
contentment with the ordinary
beliefs.lesson: being understood starts with letting people in

beliefs.label: If I take care of everyone, I'll matter to someone.
payoffs: a reputation for kindness
being indispensable to the people they love
costs: anyone ever taking care of them
the resentment they never admit to
beliefs.lesson: you mattered before you helped anyone

beliefs.label: Nothing lasts, so don't build anything you can't carry.
payoffs: freedom to move at a moment's notice
a talent for starting over
costs: a legacy
roots and community
beliefs.lesson: impermanence is a reason to build carefully, not a reason not to build

beliefs.label: Fit in fast or get left out.
payoffs: a chameleon's gift for any room
friends everywhere
costs: a self that stays the same from room to room
anyone who knows the real version
beliefs.lesson: the self you keep hiding is the one people would stay for

beliefs.label: Everyone becomes a stranger eventually, so keep your inner world to yourself.
payoffs: an inner world no move can take away
nothing to lose when it's time to go
costs: friendships that go deeper than the surface
anyone who could share what they've built inside
beliefs.lesson: letting someone in is the one thing that makes a place a home

beliefs.label: The game is rigged, so cheat before you're cheated.
payoffs: never being the sucker again
results the rules would never allow
costs: their own integrity
anyone who plays fair
beliefs.lesson: you can fight a rigged game without becoming the rigging

beliefs.label: Trust is a weakness, so verify everyone.
payoffs: never being played twice
always seeing the knife before it moves
costs: every partnership that needs a leap of faith
the mentors they never let close again
beliefs.lesson: a betrayal says more about the betrayer than about the one who trusted

beliefs.label: Doing it right should be enough, so never ask for credit.
payoffs: clean hands
work that speaks for itself, eventually
costs: the recognition they deserve
a quiet, simmering resentment
beliefs.lesson: asking for what you're owed is part of doing it right

beliefs.label: Ambition only gets you burned, so want less.
payoffs: a calm, low-stakes life
never being robbed again because there's nothing to take
costs: the work they were born to do
the person they could have become
beliefs.lesson: wanting something out loud is worth the risk of losing it

beliefs.label: Needing anything makes me a burden, so need nothing.
payoffs: never being refused
the role of the strong one
costs: support when they're breaking
relationships that run both ways
beliefs.lesson: letting people help is a gift to them, too

beliefs.label: If I don't hold it together, everything falls apart.
payoffs: a reputation as the responsible one
a sense of control
costs: the childhood they never had
ever getting to fall apart themselves
beliefs.lesson: other people can carry their share, and it was never your job to carry theirs

beliefs.label: My childhood was stolen, so I'll make up for it now.
payoffs: a hunger for life that's contagious
a refusal to be anyone's caretaker again
costs: the grown-up responsibilities they keep dodging
people who need them to show up
beliefs.lesson: you can't get the lost years back, but you can stop letting them run the present

beliefs.label: Everyone has a price, so find it first.
payoffs: always holding the leverage
never being surprised by greed
costs: the ability to recognize real kindness
friends who aren't assets
beliefs.lesson: loyalty can't be bought, but it can be built

beliefs.label: People always show their true colors eventually, so keep watching.
payoffs: an early warning system for betrayal
a short list of people who've passed every test
costs: the benefit of the doubt
relaxed, easy friendships
beliefs.lesson: most people's true colors are better than your fears

beliefs.label: People are unknowable, so study them from a distance.
payoffs: a sharp eye for what people really want
never being fooled by charm again
costs: being known themselves
the warmth of being on someone's side
beliefs.lesson: you only really know people by letting them know you

beliefs.label: Never take anyone too seriously, and they can't hurt you.
payoffs: immunity to heartbreak
a breezy charm people love
costs: anyone who wants to matter to them
the depth of real partnership
beliefs.lesson: taking someone seriously is a risk, and it's the only way to get something real

beliefs.label: I'm dangerous, so keep myself on a short leash.
payoffs: a guarantee they'll never do harm again
a penance that feels like justice
costs: their power when it's needed most
a life lived at half volume
beliefs.lesson: the capacity for harm is also the capacity for protection

beliefs.label: Following orders makes you a monster, so trust no authority.
payoffs: never being complicit again
the moral high ground
costs: every institution that could have helped
the ability to be part of something
beliefs.lesson: you can belong to something without surrendering your judgment to it

beliefs.label: What I did can't be forgiven, so I don't deserve good things.
payoffs: never having to face the people they hurt
a punishment they get to control
costs: every good thing offered to them
the chance to make real amends
beliefs.lesson: forgiveness isn't earned by suffering; it's earned by repair

beliefs.label: If I do enough good, it will balance out.
payoffs: a life of service people admire
a way to keep moving
costs: ever facing what they actually did
the people who need honesty more than help
beliefs.lesson: good deeds can't erase harm, but owning the harm makes the good deeds real

beliefs.label: Speaking up gets you punished, so go along.
payoffs: a peaceful, conflict-free life
being liked by everyone
costs: their integrity
the people who needed someone to say something
beliefs.lesson: your voice is worth the trouble it causes

beliefs.label: Being right matters more than being liked.
payoffs: a spine of steel
a clear conscience
costs: allies who share their values but not their tone
ever being wrong gracefully
beliefs.lesson: being right and being heard take different skills

beliefs.label: If they won't listen, make them.
payoffs: never being silenced again
a voice that fills any room
costs: anyone who might have listened if they'd been asked
the quiet power of persuasion
beliefs.lesson: being heard comes from trust, not volume

beliefs.label: Only power protects, so take as much as you can.
payoffs: never being helpless again
the power to shield the people they choose
costs: anyone who wants to be an equal
the person they were before
beliefs.lesson: real protection comes from people who choose to stand with you

beliefs.label: Hit back first, and they'll learn to leave you alone.
payoffs: a reputation no bully will test
never being anyone's target again
costs: people who flinch when they raise their voice
every friendship that started as a misunderstanding
beliefs.lesson: you can defend yourself without making every room a fight

beliefs.label: Money is the only real safety, so never stop saving.
payoffs: a cushion no bad month can touch
never depending on anyone's charity
costs: experiences they'll never let themselves pay for
generosity, even toward themselves
beliefs.lesson: enough is a number, and you've probably already reached it

beliefs.label: Love can vanish overnight, so always have a backup plan.
payoffs: never being caught off guard by a goodbye
an exit from every relationship
costs: the full commitment of anyone they love
ever being all in
beliefs.lesson: the backup plan is the thing that keeps love from fully arriving

beliefs.label: If I want nothing, nothing can be taken from me.
payoffs: a calm that loss can't shake
freedom from disappointment
costs: any dream worth having
the hunger that makes a life feel like theirs
beliefs.lesson: you can hold things lightly without refusing to hold them at all

beliefs.label: Feelings only make things worse, so smooth them over.
payoffs: a household with no scenes
a reputation as the reasonable one
costs: honesty in their closest relationships
knowing what they actually feel
beliefs.lesson: the feelings you smooth over don't disappear; they go underground

beliefs.label: If I'm always the one giving, no one can call me a burden.
payoffs: a pride no hardship can touch
being the one people owe
costs: ever accepting help gracefully
relationships that run both ways
beliefs.lesson: receiving is a skill, and it doesn't make you smaller

beliefs.label: If I love them hard enough, they won't leave.
payoffs: an intense, all-in devotion
being the most loving person anyone has met
costs: their own sense of self in every relationship
noticing who isn't loving them back
beliefs.lesson: love can't keep someone who's already chosen to go

beliefs.label: Other people's pain matters more than mine.
payoffs: a gift for comforting anyone
never being called selfish
costs: ever being comforted themselves
grief they've never let themselves feel
beliefs.lesson: your pain counts, even when someone else's is louder

beliefs.label: If I'm successful enough, they'll have to take me back.
payoffs: a relentless drive toward success
a story of proving everyone wrong
costs: joy in success that no one from home is there to see
the family they could build instead
beliefs.lesson: you can't earn back people who rejected who you are

beliefs.label: Only winners are safe, so never lose again.
payoffs: discipline that never quits
a record that keeps getting better
costs: any game played just for fun
grace when they come in second
beliefs.lesson: losing is survivable, and it's often where you learn the most

beliefs.label: Never let them see you struggle, or they'll use it against you.
payoffs: an image no one can crack
a cool that unsettles enemies
costs: help when they're drowning
anyone who knows the real version
beliefs.lesson: letting someone see you struggle is how you find out who's on your side

beliefs.label: Feelings change nothing, so think your way through.
payoffs: clarity in any crisis
never drowning in grief again
costs: connection with everyone who needs them to feel
knowing what they actually want
beliefs.lesson: feelings don't fix things, but they tell you what's worth fixing

beliefs.label: If I understand exactly why it happened, it can't happen again.
payoffs: expertise no one else can match
a sense of order after chaos
costs: years spent studying the past instead of living
the people who just want them back
beliefs.lesson: some things happen without a reason you can find, and you can still live fully

beliefs.label: People will use whatever they know about you, so reveal nothing.
payoffs: a perfect poker face
secrets no one can weaponize
costs: intimacy
anyone who wants to know them
beliefs.lesson: the right people use what they know about you to care for you better

beliefs.label: If I'm beyond reproach, no one can accuse me again.
payoffs: a record no one can question
unshakable integrity
costs: any mistake forgiven, even by themselves
the ease of being imperfect around people
beliefs.lesson: no amount of perfection protects you from someone determined to blame

beliefs.label: I survived for a reason, so my life has to mean something.
payoffs: a life lived with burning purpose
a story that turns loss into destiny
costs: an ordinary day without guilt
permission to just be alive
beliefs.lesson: you don't have to justify surviving; you're allowed to simply live

beliefs.label: I'll never belong, so I'll make being the outsider my identity.
payoffs: a fierce, original voice
never having to compete for a place
costs: the belonging that's actually on offer
seeing when someone is reaching out
beliefs.lesson: you can keep your edge and still let someone bring you in

beliefs.label: Ordinary life is a lie, so chase only what's intense and true.
payoffs: a life of vivid, unforgettable moments
an unflinching nose for hypocrisy
costs: the quiet, steady love that ordinary life is made of
patience with anything that isn't dramatic
beliefs.lesson: truth also lives in the boring, ordinary days

beliefs.label: My losses are what make me who I am.
payoffs: a depth of feeling no one else can match
an identity no fire can take
costs: a future that isn't defined by the past
joy that doesn't feel like betrayal
beliefs.lesson: you can honor what you lost without living inside it

sampling: On Generate, pick a belief uniformly at random (keeps the 9 strategies balanced), then a random wound linked to that belief. Re-rolls cascade downstream: wound -> belief -> strategy traits/payoff/cost/lesson. Pinned elements survive the cascade and constrain it.
